name: John Caudwell
current_role: Investor and philanthropist; founder/chair of Caudwell Children and Caudwell LymeCo (ex-founder of Phones 4u)
profile: Stoke-raised entrepreneur who started wholesaling mobile phones with brother Brian in 1987, built Singlepoint (sold to Vodafone 2003) and Phones 4u, the UK's largest independent phone retailer, and sold out in 2006 and 2011. Now invests in property, fashion and other businesses and runs his charities; Giving Pledge signatory since 2013.
interesting_fact: He founded Caudwell Children in 2000 and in 2019 opened the Caudwell International Children's Centre in Staffordshire, providing services for autistic children.
deep_cut_fact: Before phones he was an engineering apprentice-turned-foreman at Michelin, earning an HNC in mechanical engineering while running a corner shop and a mail-order clothing business for motorcyclists on the side; he later owned the F1 powerboat team Caudwell Racing (2012-14).
notes: Media-friendly, frequent interviewee (podcasts, speaker agencies). Best route is via Caudwell Children PR or his Caudwell office (caudwell.com). Keen long-distance cyclist; avoid Lyme-disease controversy angle.

name: lin Wenjing
profile: Lin Wenjing (Sutanto Djuhar, 1928-2018), Fuqing-born Indonesian-Chinese co-founder of the Salim Group, returned to Fuqing in 1987 and founded Rongqiao Group in 1989; died 2 July 2018.
notes: Deceased (2 July 2018) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sutanto_Djuhar. Rongqiao Group / Lin Wenjing Foundation now run by family; the Forbes listing may refer to heirs.

name: Otto Philipp Braun
current_role: Major family shareholder of B. Braun Melsungen AG (left the management board in Feb 2017)
profile: Sixth-generation member of the family behind B. Braun, the Melsungen medtech group that began as a pharmacy in 1839 and now makes infusion systems and surgical instruments. He ran B. Braun Brazil from 2008, then sat on the management board (Iberia/Latin America) for nine years until leaving by mutual agreement in 2017; he remains a large owner.
interesting_fact: He was the first sixth-generation family member to work in the company and serve on its board; his sister Anna Maria Braun is B. Braun's CEO.
deep_cut_fact: As MD of B. Braun Brazil (from 2008) he professionalised the Rio-based unit, introduced 'lean' processes, and oversaw a new fully automated medical-device plant in greater Rio, calling Brazil the group's 'launching hub' for Latin America (2012 interview).
notes: Very low public profile since 2017; no personal site or social accounts found. Only route is via B. Braun corporate communications (not a personal channel).

name: Frank Fertitta III
current_role: Chairman and CEO, Red Rock Resorts (Station Casinos), Las Vegas
profile: Las Vegas casino operator who runs Red Rock Resorts/Station Casinos, the locals-focused company his father founded, and took it public in 2016. With brother Lorenzo he bought the UFC for $2 million in 2001 and sold it in 2016-17 at a $4-5 billion valuation; the brothers now focus on Red Rock's expansion such as Durango Casino.
interesting_fact: He and Lorenzo got hooked on martial arts after taking weekly lessons in their casino's basement, and soon afterwards bought the UFC for $2 million.
deep_cut_fact: A 1984 USC business graduate, he was made General Manager of Palace Station in 1985 and elected to Station Casinos' board as EVP/COO the following year, still in his mid-20s.
notes: Rarely gives interviews; Lorenzo is the more public brother. Route via Red Rock Resorts corporate/IR.

name: Cao Longxiang
current_role: Chairman, Hubei Jumpcan Pharmaceutical (600566.SH) and Jiangsu Jumpcan Holding Group; co-controlling shareholder with son Cao Fei
profile: Born in 1957, Cao built Jumpcan, a Taixing (Jiangsu)-based maker of western and traditional Chinese medicines, and reverse-merged it into Shanghai-listed Hubei Hongcheng in 2013. He chairs the company and Jumpcan Holding; since 2025 he and son Cao Fei jointly control about 563 million shares, and he was renominated to the 11th board in 2026.
interesting_fact: Jumpcan's best-known products are pediatric and consumer remedies such as Pudilan anti-inflammatory oral liquid and Xiaoer Chiqiao Qingre granules (children's fever granules).
deep_cut_fact: Before pharma he served in the Chinese military and managed a cement factory; he holds an EMBA and the professional title of senior economist, and once sat on the board of Jiangsu Taixing Rural Commercial Bank.
notes: Military/cement-factory detail is from Forbes bio; EMBA/senior economist/bank board from the 2026 AGM filing. Low international profile; route via company securities department (board secretary Cao Wei). Chinese-language outreach advisable.
